sections.title: The problem
sections.html:
The problem

What it is there to fix.

Grievances arrive everywhere

Social posts, petitions and phone calls each land in a different place, and no one has the whole picture.

Routing is manual

Someone reads each item and decides where it goes, which is slow and inconsistent between shifts.

Closure is unverified

A grievance marked resolved may never have reached the citizen, and nobody is measuring the difference.

sections.title: How it works
sections.html:
How it works

From input to outcome.

  1. CaptureFrom Blura SAGA, petitions, BluVaani calls
  2. ClassifyComplaint, criticism, suggestion or query; category and station
  3. AssignRouted with a response-time timer
  4. ResolveRemarks required at every step
  5. CloseCitizen updated; monthly reports
